instructions: This workspace uses the anime-studio-kit pipeline: pure-code JavaScript anime video (MP4) + audio (MP3/WAV) generation. No generative AI in the video pipeline — deterministic hand-written code only (Canvas/SVG/WebGL/JS animation, scripted TTS/synth audio).

Skills available in ~/.config/opencode/skills/: js-animation (zero-asset canvas films, storyboard-as-data), js-soundtrack (code-synthesized scores), kinetic-typography, gsap-timeline, gsap-core, gsap-performance, gsap-plugins, animation-principles, beat-sync-editing, shot-composition, ai-video-editor (three.js 3D engine with motion blur + depth of field on HyperFrames).
Rendering: HyperFrames (npx hyperframes render) with --no-low-memory-mode -w 2 for speed. GSAP timelines drive animation; wrap window.__hf.seek for deterministic capture.
Every deliverable ships with verification: full stream decode (not header reads), duration/resolution/fps/frame-count checks, black-frame scan.
